% --- latex-dual-layer macros (auto-generated) ---
\newlength{\dlboxwidth}
\newlength{\dlboxheight}
\newlength{\dlboxdepth}
\newcommand{\duallayerbox}[2]{%
  \begingroup
  \settowidth{\dlboxwidth}{\strut #1}%
  \settoheight{\dlboxheight}{\strut #1}%
  \settodepth{\dlboxdepth}{\strut #1}%
  \ifdim\dlboxwidth=0pt
    \settowidth{\dlboxwidth}{#2}%
  \fi
  \raisebox{0pt}[\dlboxheight][\dlboxdepth]{%
    \makebox[\dlboxwidth][l]{\resizebox{\dlboxwidth}{!}{\strut #2}}%
  }%

}

\section*{True / False (26 marks)}
\textit{Answer True or False and justify briefly.}
\begin{enumerate}[label=\arabic*.]
\item True or False: The correct answer to 'Applications developed by programming languages like \_\_\_\_ and \_\_\_\_\_\_ have this common \duallayerbox{buffer-overflow error}{memory leak issue}.' is 'C, C++'.
\item True or False: The correct answer to 'When a wireless user authenticates to any AP, both of them go in the course of \duallayerbox{four-step authentication progression}{simple login process} which is called...' is 'wireless handshaking'.
\item True or False: The correct answer to 'In MD-5 the length of the \duallayerbox{message digest}{checksum} is' is '128'.
\item True or False: The correct answer to 'What are the port states determined by Nmap?' is 'Open, filtered, unfiltered'.
\item True or False: The correct answer to 'Can a stream cipher have \duallayerbox{perfect secrecy}{absolute security}?' is 'No, since the key is shorter than the message'.
\item True or False: The correct answer to 'Which of the following is not an example of \duallayerbox{presentation layer issues}{network security concerns}?' is 'Weak or non-existent authentication mechanisms'.
\item True or False: The correct answer to 'What tool can be used to perform \duallayerbox{SNMP enumeration}{network scanning}?' is 'IP Network Browser'.
\item True or False: The correct answer to 'A \duallayerbox{session symmetric key}{temporary encryption key} between two parties is used' is 'Only once'.
\item True or False: The correct answer to '\duallayerbox{Man in the middle attack}{Replay attack} can endanger the security of Diffie Hellman method if two parties are not' is 'Joined'.
\item True or False: The correct answer to 'How is \duallayerbox{IP address spoofing}{MAC address spoofing} detected?' is 'Comparing the TTL values of the actual and spoofed addresses'.
\item True or False: The correct answer to 'Which of the following is not a \duallayerbox{block cipher operating mode}{encryption algorithm}?' is 'CBF'.
\item True or False: The correct answer to 'The message must be \duallayerbox{encrypted at the sender site}{secured before transmission} and decrypted at the' is 'Sender Site'.
\item True or False: The correct answer to 'What does \duallayerbox{EXE}{the system} do when the STP solver times out on a constraint query for a particular path?' is 'Assume that the query is not satisfiable and stop executing the path'.
\end{enumerate}
